summary:
帕羅奧圖網路營收年增逾31%、EPS超預期，平台化資安策略持續放量。
• EPS 0.85美元，超越預期0.80美元，正向驚喜6.62%
• 營收30億美元，年增31.15%維持高速成長
• 平台整合策略推動次世代防火牆與雲端資安交叉銷售
• AI驅動威脅偵測強化長期競爭護城河
ai_view:
訊號正向：31%營收年增搭配EPS超標，顯示平台化與AI資安需求強勁、訂閱與支援佔比提升帶動獲利品質改善。短期動能佳，但246.79倍本益比代表市場已定價完美成長，任何RPO或剩餘履約義務增速放緩都可能引發劇烈回檔。追蹤指標：NGS年化營收、RPO與大額交易數、平台採用客戶數、自由現金流利潤率，以及全年營收與獲利指引上修幅度。

需留意：本益比246.79極高，估值對成長放緩極度敏感；資安市場競爭激烈，價格與市佔承壓；企業IT支出若收縮恐拖累訂單成長

summary_en:
Palo Alto Networks grew revenue over 31% and beat EPS, with its platformization strategy gaining scale.
• EPS of $0.85 beat the $0.80 estimate, a 6.62% positive surprise
• Revenue of $3.00B grew 31.15% year over year, sustaining rapid growth
• Platformization drives cross-sell across next-gen firewall and cloud security
• AI-driven threat detection strengthens the long-term moat

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: 31% revenue growth alongside an EPS beat reflects strong platformization and AI-security demand, with rising subscription/support mix improving earnings quality. Near-term momentum is healthy, but a 246.79x P/E prices in near-perfect execution, so any deceleration in RPO could trigger sharp drawdowns. Track: next-gen security ARR, RPO and large-deal count, platform-adopting customer count, free cash flow margin, and the magnitude of full-year revenue and earnings guidance raises.

Watch：P/E of 246.79 is extreme, leaving valuation highly sensitive to any slowdown; Intense cybersecurity competition pressures pricing and share; A pullback in enterprise IT spending could slow bookings
